prompt:
VCF Automation 9.1 is the successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation. Implement the missing `VcfAutomationClient.java` as a single dependency-free Java 17 source file. The protected `docs/contract.json` is the pinned REST contract derived from Broadcom's 9.1 xAPIs reference, and `TestMain.java` is the executable acceptance harness.

Expose the API driven by the harness: `new VcfAutomationClient(URI baseUri, String bearerToken)`, `List<Deployment> listDeployments(String projectName)`, and `void emitDeployments(String projectName, PrintStream out)`, with a public nested `Deployment` record containing `id`, `name`, and `status`. Look up the project by exact name through the documented projects collection and use the identifier returned by that lookup when filtering deployments. Retrieve every deployment page with zero-based `page`, `size=2`, and the `projects` filter; do not stop after the first page. Return deployments in stable Java string order by `name`, then `id`. `emitDeployments` must emit one UTF-8 JSON object per line with keys in exactly `id`, `name`, `status` order and valid JSON escaping. Send the supplied bearer token on every request and surface non-2xx responses as failures. Use only the Java 17 standard library.

Run `bash run_verify.sh`. The harness uses a loopback server and dummy credentials; it never contacts a live VMware endpoint. Do not modify the protected harness, mock, script, or documentation fixtures.
